# Lab 24.1: Recommendations Tour

## What We Are Going to Do
Explore all BigQuery recommendations, read their estimated savings, and apply or dismiss them.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Open Recommendations.** **Administration → Recommendations**. You may see:
   - **Partition and cluster** tables
   - **Create materialized views**
   - **Slot / edition** capacity changes
   - **Delete unused tables or datasets**

   Recommendations are refreshed daily from the last 30 days of usage. A new project may have none yet.

2. **[SQL] List them with SQL.**

<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT recommender, subtype, primary_impact, target_resources, state, last_updated_time
FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.RECOMMENDATIONS
ORDER BY last_updated_time DESC;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[CLI] List them with the Recommender API.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable recommender.googleapis.com
gcloud recommender recommendations list --project=$PROJECT_ID --location=us \
  --recommender=google.bigquery.table.PartitionClusterRecommender --format="table(name.basename(), description, stateInfo.state)"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[Console] Dismiss one.** Open a recommendation you don't want and click **Dismiss**. Its state becomes `DISMISSED` and it stops showing.

5. **Discuss.** Recommendations are a starting point. Always check them against how the table is really used.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Sources | Your query history |
| Refresh | Daily |
| Views | `INFORMATION_SCHEMA.RECOMMENDATIONS` |
| Actions | Apply or dismiss |
